Our Public House

When an entire community spoils their ballots and refuses to vote, a local pub on the brink of closure becomes the only place left to talk - and sing. As a storm rages outside, landlady Sanjana, a family in mourning, familiar regulars and some unexpected guests are thrown together for one long night.. Inspired by the real words of over 600 people nationwide, Our Public House transforms these words into original live music, filling the room with debate, warmth and laughter.
